actors.description: Watch ACT Access Canberra COLA licence numbers for Active/Expired/Suspended/Cancelled status and occupation changes from the official List of Professionals open dataset. Pay per change. Personal names never output.

events.title: ACT COLA licence status event delivered

actors.name: au-asic-credit-licence-number-portfolio-status-monitor
actors.title: ASIC Credit Licence Monitor: Status & Suspension Alerts
actors.description: Watch ASIC Credit Licence Numbers for approval/suspension status, name and authorisation changes from the official ASIC register. Pay only per delivered change.

actors.name: australia-abn-status-portfolio-monitor
actors.title: Australia ABN Status Portfolio Monitor
actors.description: Watch a list of Australian Business Numbers and emit typed ABN status / GST / entity name+type change events from free official ABR GUID web services. Not CreditorWatch. Not a nationwide ABN dump.

actors.name: au-apvma-product-number-portfolio-status-monitor
actors.title: Australia APVMA Product Monitor: Registration Status Alerts
actors.description: Watch APVMA product registration numbers from the official Australian pesticides and veterinary medicines register. Get an alert when registration status changes. Pay only per delivered change.

actors.name: au-asic-financial-adviser-number-portfolio-status-monitor
actors.title: Australia ASIC Financial Adviser Portfolio Status Monitor
actors.description: Watch named ASIC Financial Advisers Register adviser numbers; emit registration status, banning/disciplinary, CPD-failure and AFSL authorisation added/ceased events from the official ASIC Financial Advisers Dataset (data.gov.au). Portfolio PPE only - not a FAR dump.

actors.name: au-casa-reg-mark-portfolio-status-monitor
actors.title: CASA Aircraft Mark Monitor: Suspension & Holder Alerts
actors.description: Watch Australian VH aircraft marks for insurers, lessors and MROs: alerts when CASA shows suspension, deregistration, full-registration return, or holder/operator changes from the official daily register. Portfolio PPE — not an FAA N-Number twin or national dump.

events.title: CASA aircraft registration status event delivered

actors.name: au-qld-ea-permit-reference-portfolio-status-monitor
actors.title: QLD EA Permit Monitor: Status Change Alerts
actors.description: Watch Queensland Environmental Authority Permit References for appear/drop and status changes from official DESI open data. Pay only per delivered change.

actors.name: au-qld-enforcement-reference-portfolio-status-monitor
actors.title: Queensland Enforcement Monitor: Action Status Alerts
actors.description: Watch Queensland DESI Environmental Enforcement Action References for appear/drop and status changes from official open data. Pay only per delivered change.

actors.name: brazil-cnpj-situacao-change-monitor
actors.title: Brazil CNPJ Situação Change Monitor (honest monthly lag)
actors.description: Watch a list of Brazilian CNPJs and emit typed situação cadastral / material change events from Receita Federal dados abertos (or equivalent open-data mirror). Honest monthly official lag — not a CNPJ dump, not paid Serasa.

actors.name: lookalike-ct-brand-abuse-monitor
actors.title: Lookalike Domain CT Brand-Abuse Monitor
actors.description: Generate lookalikes (dnstwist-class, in-process) for brand apexes, join public CT via crt.sh, and emit LOOKALIKE_CERT_ISSUED events when a lookalike gets a new TLS cert. Not a TLS dump; not dnstwist-only.

actors.name: fmcsa-carrier-lookup
actors.title: FMCSA Carrier Lookup by USDOT/MC: Authority, Safety, Contacts
actors.description: Look up trucking companies by USDOT or MC number, or search new and existing carriers by state, name and fleet size. Get authority status, out-of-service, safety rating, inspections, crashes, trucks, drivers, phone and email from official FMCSA data. Optional change alerts. No API key.

actors.name: iana-icann-registrar-id-portfolio-status-monitor
actors.title: IANA Registrar ID Monitor: Accreditation Status Alerts
actors.description: Watch IANA Registrar IDs for registries and brand-protection teams: Accredited/Terminated/Reserved flips plus name/RDAP URL changes from the official registrar-ids CSV. Not a WHOIS/RDAP domain lookup; not a full IANA dump.

actors.name: icann-gtld-registry-operator-portfolio-status-monitor
actors.title: ICANN gTLD Registry-Operator Portfolio Status Monitor
actors.description: Watch ICANN gTLD strings for registry-operator / contract portfolio status changes from the official gtlds.json feed (DELEGATED, CONTRACT_TERMINATED, REMOVED). Not an IANA Registrar ID twin; not a WHOIS/zone-file domain twin; not a full gTLD dump billed as rows.

actors.name: lei-lookup-gleif-search
actors.title: LEI Lookup & GLEIF Search: Status, Renewal Date, Parent Company
actors.description: Look up any LEI or search the official GLEIF database by name, country or status. Get legal name, LEI status, next renewal date, addresses, company number and parent company for every LEI, with optional change alerts. No API key.

actors.name: nz-charities-register-cc-number-portfolio-status-monitor
actors.title: New Zealand Charities Register Portfolio Status Monitor
actors.description: Watch named New Zealand Charities Register CC numbers; emit Registered/Deregistered/Removed status events (with deregistration date + reason) and register notices from official Charities Services open data. Portfolio PPE only - not a register dump.

actors.name: ch-swissmedic-zulassungsnummer-portfolio-status-monitor
actors.title: Swissmedic Monitor: Authorization Number Status Alerts
actors.description: Watch Swissmedic Zulassungsnummer on the official HAM authorized-medicines list. Get an alert when authorization turns on/off or a number appears or drops. Pay only per delivered change.

actors.name: who-pq-fpp-reference-number-portfolio-status-monitor
actors.title: WHO PQ Medicine Monitor: FPP Listing Status Alerts
actors.description: Watch WHO Prequalification Finished Pharmaceutical Product (FPP) reference numbers on the official PQ list. Get an alert when a product appears, drops or its listing basis changes. Pay only per delivered change.

events.title: WHO PQ FPP status event delivered
